name: Introduction to Bases - Obsidian Help
snippet: Bases is a core plugin that lets you create database-like views of your notes. Using a base you can view, edit, sort, and filter files and their properties.

name: An Overview of the Bases Core Plugin in Obsidian
snippet: May 26, 2025 — The ability to create dynamic table views using data stored in note properties . The functionality is delivered via a new Core Plugin , Bases .

name: Unlocking the Magic of Bases in Obsidian | by Len
snippet: Bases allows you to create views — custom tables of your notes — based on properties (your note metadata), folders, tags, and even dates.
